name: ds1
style: Flat 2D side view illustration from a children's picture book about dinosaurs. {subject}, the whole animal visible, cute and friendly with a happy face, isolated and centered on a solid uniform pure chroma-key magenta (#FF00FF) background. No black outlines: shapes are flat colour fills only. Every colour has a second, slightly darker flat shade on its lower or shadow side, giving a simple two-tone shading. Bright colours, clean simple shapes. No pink, purple or magenta anywhere on the animal. No text, no clouds, no plants, no ground, no shadow, no scenery.

items.pteranodon: A single Pteranodon flying facing right seen from the side, both big leathery wings raised high above its back in a V shape, a long pointed beak and a long backward pointing crest on its head, small legs tucked under its body, light blue grey body and wings with a cream belly and an orange crest
items.quetzalcoatlus: A single giant Quetzalcoatlus flying facing right seen from the side, both huge wide leathery wings raised high above its back in a V shape, a very long neck and an enormous long pointed beak, a small crest, tiny legs tucked under, sandy brown and white body with tan wings and a red brown head
items.rhamphorhynchus: A single small Rhamphorhynchus flying facing right seen from the side, both leathery wings raised high above its back, a long beak full of little pointy teeth, a long thin tail with a diamond shaped vane at the tip, orange brown body and wings with a yellow belly
items.tapejara: A single Tapejara flying facing right seen from the side, both leathery wings raised high above its back in a V shape, a short downturned beak and a huge tall rounded sail crest on its head in bright red and yellow, a teal blue body with a pale belly and teal wings
items.dimorphodon: A single Dimorphodon standing on all fours on the ground facing right with its wings folded at its sides, a big tall puffin like head with a deep beak, a long thin tail, yellow and black striped beak, dark brown and orange body
items.archaeopteryx: A single Archaeopteryx perched facing right seen from the side, a small feathered dinosaur bird with brown and black feathered wings slightly open, little clawed fingers on its wings, a toothy beak, a long bony feathered tail, dark brown and black feathers with a cream belly
items.microraptor: A single Microraptor gliding facing right seen from the side, a small feathered dinosaur with feathered wings on its arms spread wide and a second pair of long feathers on its legs, a long feathered tail fan, glossy dark blue black feathers with a shimmering blue sheen, a small head with big eyes
